articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI chatbot got social-engineered harder than a freshman at DEFCON, leading to Obama's Instagram getting decorated with Iranian propaganda. When your "smart" AI falls for basic human manipulation, maybe it's time to reconsider calling it intelligence.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor yeeted AWS GovCloud keys and internal secrets onto public GitHub because apparently cybersecurity agencies are just as good at OpSec as your average startup. The irony is so thick you could cut it with a rusty CVE.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI pick highlights why Section 702's warrantless mass surveillance needs to die in a fire. When political hacks get the keys to the panopticon, maybe it's time to question why the panopticon exists at all.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is getting hammered in the wild with no patch in sight. Sysadmins everywhere are updating their résumés and contemplating careers in organic farming.

articles.title: AI Agent Uncovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg; Chrome Patches Record 429 Bugs
articles.summary: CISA adds actively exploited SolarWinds Serv-U flaw to KEV catalog because apparently SolarWinds wasn't done being a cybersecurity punchline. Some companies just can't help themselves.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: AI agent autonomously discovered 21 zero-days in FFmpeg while Chrome patched a record 429 bugs. The robots are getting scary good at finding holes in our digital house of cards.

articles.title: Is Cybersecurity Hard? Honest Career Guide for 2026
articles.summary: Miasma worm infected 73 Microsoft GitHub repos in a supply chain attack that spread like gossip at a security conference. When even Microsoft can't keep their own repos clean, we're all doomed.

articles.title: It's So Over for Crypto
articles.summary: Reports claim Anthropic deployed engineers to help NSA use restricted AI model Mythos for cybersecurity. Nothing says "don't be evil" like secretly helping the surveillance state upgrade their digital panopticon.

articles.title: Meta confirms 1000s of Instagram accounts were hacked by abusing its AI chatbot
articles.summary: Claude Opus AI discovered a four-year-old critical Zcash flaw that could enable undetectable counterfeit coin creation. When AI starts auditing crypto better than humans, the future is both terrifying and hilarious.

articles.title: CBSE retains COEMPT for answer-sheet scanning, shifts data to its own servers
articles.summary: Former IBM cybersecurity exec blows whistle on company allegedly covering up years of Chinese state hacking. Corporate malfeasance meets geopolitical espionage in this thrilling episode of "why we can't have nice things."
